selected_hypothesis_text: Laboratory mechanisms can remain reproducible without becoming Architecture Canon.

selection_basis.plan_reason: Lowest execution burden and protects all later families from profile-to-Canon leakage.
selection_basis.bounded_rationale: H11 is selected first because it directly protects the architecture/reference-laboratory boundary before later residual families rely on additional profile or substrate mechanisms. This is a preregistration-selection decision only, not an A10 outcome change.

h11_boundary.testable_question: Can exact reproduction of accepted laboratory evidence depend on profile-specific Python/SQL/JSON/hash/Event/reducer details while the Architecture specification and conformance oracle remain meaning-level and do not mandate those mechanisms universally?

explicit_non_targets: runtime expansion or product runtime integration
acceptance_effect: If this candidate selection is merged and later bound into current truth, A10-H11 becomes the sole family admitted to the separate preregistration gate. The selection package itself does not preregister H11 and cannot authorize implementation or execution.
